summary: Tested Phase-based Milestone Model for Gantt Chart. All backend tests passed (10/10). Frontend UI tests verified bidirectional sync between WaveContent inline editor and Payment Milestones page, milestone diamonds on Gantt chart, and phase linking with position (start/mid/end).
seed_data_creation: Test milestones created and cleaned up: 'Test Explore Milestone' (Explore/Mid) and 'PM Page Test Milestone' (Prepare/Start)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-based milestone model fully working: Milestones can be linked to phases (Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare) with positions (start/mid/end). Target month auto-computes based on phase range. Bidirectional sync works between WaveContent inline editor and Payment Milestones page via shared /api/projects/{id}/milestones endpoint. Gantt chart renders milestone diamonds at correct positions. Debounced save (800ms) prevents excessive API calls.

milestone_api_get.details: GET /api/projects/{id}/milestones returns milestones with phase_name and position fields

milestone_api_put.details: PUT /api/projects/{id}/milestones saves milestones with phase_name and position, persists correctly

inline_editor_add_milestone.details: + Milestone button in Phase Ranges section adds milestone linked to phase with auto-computed target_month

inline_editor_position_dropdown.details: Position dropdown (Start/Mid/End) updates target_month based on phase range

payment_milestones_page_sync.details: Milestones added from inline editor appear on Payment Milestones page with correct phase_name and position

payment_milestones_add_with_phase.details: Adding milestone from PM page with Linked Phase dropdown and Position dropdown works correctly

bidirectional_sync.details: Milestones added from PM page appear in inline editor on estimator page

gantt_milestone_diamonds.details: Milestone diamonds (SVG polygons with #F59E0B fill) render on Gantt chart at correct phase positions

gantt_milestone_positioning.details: Milestones positioned at phase start/mid/end based on position field

debounced_save.details: saveGanttMilestones uses 800ms debounce to prevent excessive API calls
